definitions.gloss: severe winter; harsh winter; the coldest period of winter
definitions.explanation: refers to the harshest, coldest part of winter or an exceptionally cold winter

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}は{厳冬|げんとう}になりそうだ。
examples.english: This year looks like it will be a severe winter.

examples.japanese: {厳冬|げんとう}の{北海道|ほっかいどう}を{旅行|りょこう}した。
examples.english: I traveled to Hokkaido in the harsh winter.

examples.japanese: {厳冬|げんとう}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}えるために{防寒対策|ぼうかんたいさく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: Cold weather measures are necessary to get through the harsh winter.

notes:
SEASONAL VOCABULARY:
{厳冬|げんとう} describes either:
1. The coldest part of winter (typically January-February in Japan)
2. An exceptionally severe winter season

RELATED SEASONAL TERMS:
- {初冬|しょとう} - early winter
- {真冬|まふゆ} - midwinter, depth of winter
- {晩冬|ばんとう} - late winter
- {暖冬|だんとう} - mild winter (opposite)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厳冬|げんとう}を{迎|むか}える - to enter the harsh winter
- {厳冬|げんとう}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}える - to get through the severe winter
- {厳冬|げんとう}の{候|こう} - during the severe winter (formal letter writing)

RELATED WORDS:
- {厳寒|げんかん} - severe cold
- {極寒|ごっかん} - extreme cold
- {酷寒|こっかん} - bitter cold
